items.name: browser-device-stage
items.title: Browser Device Stage
items.description: A generic app surface in token-native device chrome (browser, window, or phone). The screen is a slot for caller img/video/HTML with a token-styled skeleton default; one settle entrance, a readable hold, and an optional screen swap.
items.attribution: Browser Device Stage from the HyperFrames catalog (https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/tree/cfe5dcfad310ced2a5844998628daa2b8a0f53d7/registry)

variables.label: Chrome
variables.description: Device frame drawn around the screen slot.

variables.label: Title
variables.description: Address pill text (browser) or title bar text (window).

variables.label: Swap at
variables.description: Seconds from mount start to swap to the second screen. 0 disables the swap.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Token the skeleton accent elements ride.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. None holds the final frame.

items.name: before-after-wipe
items.title: Before After Wipe
items.description: Two full-bleed content slots compare before and after states as a persistent divider wipes the after layer over the before layer and rests at a configurable split. Callers fill the named before/after slot panels; token-styled defaults render when a slot is left empty.
items.attribution: Before After Wipe from the HyperFrames catalog (https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/tree/cfe5dcfad310ced2a5844998628daa2b8a0f53d7/registry)

variables.label: Before label
variables.description: Chip shown on the base before panel. Blank hides the chip.

variables.label: After label
variables.description: Chip shown on the revealed after panel. Blank hides the chip.

variables.label: Resting split
variables.description: Divider resting position after the wipe lands.

variables.label: Wipe start
variables.description: Seconds after mount start when the wipe begins.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Divider handle and after chip color.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Outgoing transition. None holds the final comparison frame.
